dog.description_text:
This pet needs emergency placement. Please click here to go to our emergency placement page for more information.

Bruno is on the at-risk list due to behavior concerns. In the care center, Bruno has shown high arousal and persistent leash biting, including repeatedly grabbing at the leash, lunging at the kennel door, and attempting to rush out when opened. He has also displayed significant dog-directed reactivity and hard pulling on walks, making him difficult for staff to manage. Bruno's leash biting has become increasingly difficult to redirect with treats, but has been reported to be social with staff but is struggling to acclimate. Medically, Bruno is apparently healthy.
dog.name: Bruno
